metadata.source: Y. Arosa and R. de la Fuente. Refractive index spectroscopy and material dispersion in fused silica glass. Opt. Lett. 45, 4268-4271 (2020) (https://doi.org/10.1364/OL.395510); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description: Fused silica. The accuracy of refractive index measurements is lower than those reported by Malitson. However, by combining phase velocity and group velocity dispersion data, the authors have derived a potentially more accurate Sellmeier formula.
